description: Eight simulated weeks: 120 unrelated facts, an editor theme reinforced six times, a release cadence changed nine days ago and a team name stated 140 days ago. Limit: flat 45-day decay archives a still-valid fact left unused, and recall never supplies a replaced value. Failure means: team-old failing is a design question (a valid but unused fact fades); cadence-before failing is the absent capability to recall an earlier value; the two controls (theme-now, cadence-now) must pass. Maintenance: run with maintenance on; fading of the aged records is part of what is measured (the stable fact, unused and old, is expected to be archived); the superseded record stays as history since #4223, and the earlier-value probe fails because recall does not supply history yet, not because a record was lost. Kind: design.
